name: com.henorek.crashczyk.activity.DefaultErrorActivity
description: Crashczyk, Henorek’s Android crash-handler library, launches this Activity after it catches an uncaught app error. It shows an error screen with restart and optional error-detail and copy actions.
disableEffect: After an app crash, users lose Crashczyk’s restart and error-details screen, and the crash handler may fail when it tries to open the disabled screen.
